textos.Só os Cartões Evento associados a client: Only Event Cards linked to customers. Each movement counts in the account of the customer who owned the card at that moment. Purchases: card payments minus voids and refunds. Other: balance withdrawals, transfers between cards and customer changes. A top-up is not a sale: the cash sale is issued on purchase.
textos.Apaga apenas o que já não serve ao negóc: Only deletes what the business no longer needs. Orders, payments, tax documents, cash, stock and card movements and the audit log are never deleted. Every cleanup is recorded in the audit log.
textos.Com os filtros do ecrã, todas as páginas: With the filters on screen, all pages.
textos.Se as tabelas de vendas ou auditoria se: If the sales or audit tables approach the limit, the answer is to archive old years, never to delete them.
textos.Compras confirmadas menos os pagamentos: Confirmed purchases minus the supplier payments recorded on the purchase (Purchases → open the purchase → Payments). Overdue: past the due date; purchases without a due date count as not due. Payments are by payment date.
textos.Contas de mesa pagas no período, pela da: Table bills paid in the period, by payment date. Time: from opening the order to payment.
textos.Cotações pela data de emissão. Taxa de c: Quotes by issue date. Conversion rate: converted over not cancelled. Expired: still open and past the validity date.
textos.Do envio para a cozinha até ser marcado: From sending to the kitchen until marked "ready" on the kitchen screen, by send date. Cancelled items do not count.
textos.Em média, uma cotação passa a factura em: On average, a quote becomes an invoice in
textos.Mostram-se só as primeiras 5000 cotações: Only the first 5000 quotes are shown.
textos.Mostram-se só as primeiras 5000 reservas: Only the first 5000 reservations are shown.
textos.Número de pedidos em cada hora; quanto m: Number of orders in each hour; the darker, the more sold.
textos.Pedidos de Delivery e Take Away pela dat: Delivery and Take Away orders by creation date; value only of paid ones. Delivery time counts until the order is marked "Delivered".
textos.Pedidos pagos, pela hora local do pagame: Paid orders, by local payment time. Average per day: weekday value divided by how many times that day occurs in the period.
textos.Reservas pela data marcada. Faltou: pend: Reservations by booked date. No-show: pending or confirmed and more than 1 hour past the booked time without the customer arriving.
